title: HUD compass points nowhere for the whole mid and late main story (both arcs)
repro: GoalLine.goal_place() only has cases for first_harvest, meet_town, clear_meadow, cattopia, spark, hideout, gang. For wastes_gate, commander, sky_stair, knight, teleporter, finale (penguins) and docks, neon, pit, uptown, tower (gangsters) it returns ['',''], so QuestTracker.target() (untracked = story) gives Vector2.ZERO and the compass is hidden, even though the goal line names a place (e.g. 'Defeat the Grump Commander in the Wastes (east gate of the crystal meadow)', 'Climb the great tree in the forest', 'Power the moon teleporter (mountain pad...)'). 'gang' after hideout_seen also returns nowhere although the text names Deuce and Mama Rosa in Hideout town; 'spark' with <10 stone / <3 shards points nowhere.
fix: Add goal_place cases: wastes_gate/commander -> crystal_meadow east gate (thing/exit to wastes) then the boss in wastes; sky_stair -> mountain pass camp until babies_done/campfire_done, then forest great tree; knight -> sky; teleporter -> mountain moon pad (thing), finale -> moon spire; docks/neon/pit/uptown/tower -> the region entry (hideout/neon exits) then the boss; gang after hideout_seen -> npc:deuce / npc:rosa in hideout; spark short on stone/shards -> mountain (rocks). When Campaign.story_pointer is non-empty (region held) return ['', ''] (board is in the menu). Make GoalLine.ADJ reach the story scenes (crystal_meadow->wastes, forest->sky stair, mountain->moon pad, hideout->docks/neon...). Extend tools/quest_tracker_test.gd: every main step has a non-zero target from the farm once its region is open.

title: Tracked townsfolk job: compass vanishes in town whenever the giver is indoors, at the community farm or at the Rec Center
repro: Track any Valley side quest (e.g. maple_turnips), walk to town in the evening or while Maple is at 'work'/'home' (Npc._apply_routine sets visible=false), or on a volunteer day (Commons.slot -> cf_* place, she is on the community_farm map) or a Rec evening (RecCenter.visit). QuestTracker._giver_target skips invisible Npcs, then returns Vector2.ZERO because here == 'town'. Compass disappears; no hint where she is. From the community farm map the giver is found, but from town it never points west to it.
fix: In _giver_target, when the giver Npc isn't visible on this map, resolve Npc.place_now(GameState.npcs[giver].routine, giver): cf_* -> GoalLine.exit_toward(m,'community_farm'); 'rec' -> the rec lot door; home/work/inn/school/etc -> the door thing whose interior == npcs[giver].home/work (same lookup as Npc.walk_off); inside that interior target the Npc. Extend tools/quest_tracker_test.gd with a giver-indoors and giver-at-community-farm case.

title: Rook's orchard job (rook_tracks): the grumps/thugs only appear after leaving and re-entering town
repro: Rook offers rook_tracks in town (friend 6, after clear_meadow); accept. town.gd after_ready spawns the 3 orchard foes and sets _orchard_watch only when the map loads with the quest already open, so right after accepting the orchard (75..81, 10..22) is empty; Rook's 'wait' line says 'The orchard. Grumps. Still there.' The quest can't progress until the player leaves town and comes back, and nothing says so. Also no tracker target: the compass points at Rook (the giver), not the orchard.
fix: Move the spawn into a town func spawn_orchard() called from after_ready and from Quests.talk right after GameState.add_quest (e.g. if m.has_method('on_quest_taken'): m.on_quest_taken(qid2)). Have the tracker point at the orchard cells while rook_orchard_clear is unset (see the non-item side quest finding).

title: Non-item side quests: compass points at the giver instead of where the job is done, with no progress caption
repro: Track rec_bowl_120 / rec_maple_league / rec_theo_stack / rec_wren_jr_duck / rec_sal_whack / rec_pip_jumper / rec_alder_cabinets (done at the Rec Center), rook_tracks (town orchard), benno_pup_stay (Pup tab), rook_pup_hunt/guard (pup level), mer_crystals (mine floor 5, no giver). QuestTracker.target -> _giver_target(giver) always, and caption() -> progress() returns '' for flag/skill/rec_best/arcade_ms. mer_crystals has giver '' so the compass is hidden entirely.
fix: Before the job is ready (done_when not met) point at the place of action: rec_best/arcade_ms/bowl flag -> rec lot door (town); rook_orchard_clear -> orchard cells (or the nearest live orchard foe); grotto_done -> mine entrance (meadow); pup skill/pup_stay -> no target but caption 'Pup Lv 2/3' / 'Pup tab'. progress(): add skill ('Lv a/b'), rec_best ('best/target' via Tickets best), arcade_ms. Once ready, point at the giver as now.

title: Quests with no giver (rec_visit, cf_main, colony_*, mer_crystals) can't be tracked at all and the story compass never points at them
repro: Day 7+: 'Visit the new Rec Center south-east of the library' (rec_visit, rec_center.gd:60), the community farm entry (Commons.QUEST 'cf_main'), colony quests (colony.gd:137 'colony_<id>') and mer_crystals have giver '' and no main entry. game_menu.gd Quests tab (632-634) lists them as plain '•' lines under Story (no checkbox), and QuestTracker would give Vector2.ZERO for them anyway (_giver_target(m,'')). GoalLine.goal_place only knows main ids, so nothing ever points at the Rec Center, community farm, colony or the grotto dive.
fix: Make giverless non-main quests tickable rows (game_menu.gd Quests tab: checkbox_row like townsfolk jobs) and give QuestTracker.target a per-id place table: rec_visit -> rec lot door in town (exit_toward town elsewhere); cf_main -> GoalLine.exit_toward(m,'community_farm') (stage spot when there); colony_<id> -> the colony region entry (_toward on its scene); mer_crystals -> meadow mine entrance. A tracked quest with no place should fall back to GoalLine.target rather than an empty compass. Cover these ids in tools/quest_tracker_test.gd.

title: Region villagers' jobs (Tam, Old Moss, Granite, Sel): compass blank everywhere but their own map, because GoalLine.ADJ/adj() skip the Valley's outer regions
repro: Reach 6 hearts with Tam (orchard_hills), Old Moss (marsh), Granite (quarry) or Sel (hollow_heart) and track tam_lamb / tam_orchard / moss_glowcaps / granite_bones / sel_fossil. QuestTracker._giver_target -> npc_scene -> _toward(m, 'orchard_hills') -> GoalLine.exit_toward -> next_hop: ADJ has forest:[farm,lake], beach:[town], mountain:[town], meadow:[farm,crystal_meadow] and adj() only adds regions with 'mega', so orchard_hills/highlands/quarry/marsh/riverlands/hollow_heart/hollow_deeps are unreachable in the graph; MegaTravel.region_of is '' for them -> Vector2.ZERO. Real exits: forest->orchard_hills, mountain->highlands/quarry, beach->marsh/quarry, meadow->hollow_heart (regions.json exits). The same gap stops any future goal_place in these regions.
fix: Build adj() for every regions.json area with 'exits' (not only 'mega'), and add the Valley-side links to ADJ (forest+orchard_hills, mountain+highlands+quarry, beach+marsh+quarry, meadow+hollow_heart+mine), or read them from each Valley map's add_exit list once. Test: next_hop('farm','quarry') etc. non-empty for every region with an npc giver (tools/quest_tracker_test.gd).

title: Marlowe's and Orla's jobs point to town, but both live at the lake (lighthouse / water mill)
repro: Track lighthouse_oil, lighthouse_lens, marlowe_salmon (giver marlowe) or orla_oil (giver orla). Neither is a regions.json npc, so QuestTracker._giver_target falls to 'Valley villagers live in town' -> from the farm the compass points at the town road, and in town it shows nothing. Marlowe stands at lake.gd (11,31) (talk via lake._talk_marlowe); Orla keeps the water mill shop (lake.gd:142, interiors water_mill). The map pin card (QuestTracker.quests_at('lake')) doesn't list them either. Any routine-less villager (empty routine in npcs.json: marlowe, orla, granite, tam, old_moss, sel) has the same risk.
fix: Give QuestTracker a giver->scene map for villagers who don't live in town: derive from npcs.json home (lighthouse/water_mill -> 'lake', etc.) or add an explicit 'scene' field per npc in its generator; npc_scene() should check it before regions.json. In the lake, target Marlowe's Npc or the water_mill door (Orla is inside). Test both in tools/quest_tracker_test.gd.

title: Mega region jobs have no 'wait' line: the villager says 'Still waiting on that: odette wants 3 gold leaf...' about herself, names lowercased
repro: Take mega_giltcity_job (or any mega_*_job / mega_sunscorch_rahim), talk to the giver before it's done. data/quest_lines.json has offer/done but no 'wait' for these 7 quests, so Quests.talk uses dflt = 'Still waiting on that: ' + text.to_lower() -> 'Still waiting on that: odette wants 3 gold leaf and a pearl necklace for her masterpiece.' spoken by Odette.
fix: gen_mega_new.py: write a 'wait' line per job (first person, with what's still short). Quests.talk default: don't lowercase; use a first-person form, e.g. 'Still need %s.' built from done_when via QuestTracker.progress (item names + counts).

title: Side-quest texts that point the player the wrong way (what counts / where to find it)
repro: Valley side quests are hand-kept in data/quests.json. sal_fish: 'Sal wants 5 fish, no questions' but only minnow counts (done_when minnow x5) - bass/trout show 0/5. wrenjr_frog: '(Bring 2 bugs instead.)' but the item is Bait, sold at Finn's bait shop / Marlowe; nothing says so. wren_glowcap / moss_glowcaps: 'only show after dark in the forest' but forest forage has no night gate (forage.json forest glowcap needs foraging 3 at any hour); Old Moss himself sells glowcaps (shops.gd old_moss) yet asks for 3. wren_moonwort / lumi_moonwort (gangsters): 'by the orchard wall' - moonwort only grows in Orchard Hills (forage.json), north of the forest, not Rook's town orchard. finn_trout: 'by week's end' - there is no deadline. theo_coffee: 'coffee beans you grew yourself' - shop coffee counts too. orla_oil: Marlowe sells the lamp oil Orla asks you to bring for Marlowe.
fix: Reword: sal_fish 'Sal wants 5 minnows'; wrenjr_frog 'Bring 2 Bait (Finn's bait shop)'; glowcap quests 'in the forest (Foraging 3)' and Old Moss's ask -> something he doesn't sell (or drop glowcap from his shop); moonwort 'in Orchard Hills, north of the forest'; drop 'by week's end' and 'you grew yourself'; orla_oil -> flour/wheat-based ask or remove lamp_oil from Marlowe's stock. Mirror the wording in the quest_lines offer lines.

title: Quest rows never show what or where for non-Valley/region givers; mg_ and region villagers get no 'Name:' prefix and Quests tab misses region-giver location
repro: Quests tab (game_menu.gd 636-644) prefixes 'Name:' from GameState.npcs only; region villagers (tam, old_moss, granite, sel, all mg_*) and keeper hooks (gate_*) aren't in npcs.json, so rows like 'Tam wants 10 fiber...' give no place, and the compass is blank for them (see the ADJ finding). The player can't tell where Tam/Granite/Sel live from the log.
fix: Add a place tag to townsfolk rows from QuestTracker.npc_scene / the gate entry: e.g. sub-caption or suffix '(Orchard Hills)', '(Quarry)', '(Gloamwood)' via PlaceNames.for_id(scene).

title: Colony quests (colony_<id>) show one static line: no progress (foes/beacons/supplies) in the log and nothing to track
repro: Meet a colony elder: colony.gd:137 adds 'colony_<id>' with '<Colony>: help <elder> save the colony's star crystal.' The real steps (supplies to the elder, N foes, 3 beacons, then wake the crystal and beat the boss) only appear when you talk to the elder or crystal (Colony._status). Menu > Quests shows the static line as a non-tickable bullet; QuestTracker.progress returns ''; the compass never points at the elder, the next beacon or the crystal.
fix: QuestTracker.progress('colony_<id>') -> Colony._status short form ('foes 3/8, beacons 1/3, supplies ✗'); make it a tickable row; target: elder until supplies given, else nearest unlit beacon, else the star crystal (when ready_to_wake). Optionally refresh the run quest text from Colony._status like Commons.sync_quest does.

title: Gangster main steps after the first crew never say where to go (docks, neon, pit, uptown)
repro: Once their campaign region is open (Campaign.story_pointer ''), GameState.next_step shows the raw quest text because GoalLine.text has no case: docks 'The docks move everything. Take them from the dock boss.' (reached by the city bus in Hideout town), neon 'Put out Flame in the neon district.' (east exit of the docks), pit 'Win the fight pit under the neon street.' (the manhole at neon 26,23), uptown (east exit of neon). Penguin steps mostly name the place in the text (Wastes via crystal meadow east gate, great tree in the forest, mountain pad); knight just says 'the sky islands' (the great tree in the forest).
fix: Add GoalLine.text cases, scene-aware like clear_meadow: docks -> 'Take the city bus from Hideout town to the docks. Beat the dock boss.'; in docks -> where the boss is; neon -> 'East from the docks to Neon...'; pit -> 'The manhole on the neon street leads down to the pit.'; uptown/tower -> 'East from Neon to Uptown...'; knight -> 'Climb the great tree in the forest to the sky islands.' Keep under ~112 chars. Pair with the goal_place cases from the compass finding.
